title: What makes housing adequate?

captions.instagram:
UN-Habitat counts 2.8 billion people without adequate housing. So what does "adequate" mean?

The UN Committee on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights lists seven elements: security of tenure, services and infrastructure, affordability, habitability, accessibility, location and cultural adequacy.

I keep this list close. Save it.

#Housing #AffordableHousing #HumanRights

Which element is hardest where you live?
captions.facebook:

#Housing #AffordableHousing

Which element would you add first to your city's checklist?
captions.linkedin:
Before we talk about how many homes the world needs, we should agree on what counts as a home.

The UN Committee on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights lists seven elements of adequate housing: security of tenure, services and infrastructure, affordability, habitability, accessibility, location and cultural adequacy.

By that standard, UN-Habitat counts 2.8 billion people without adequate housing, 1.1 billion living in slums or informal settlements, and more than 300 million who are homeless.

#Housing #HumanRights

Which element do new projects most often miss?
